companies.name: Schneider Electric
companies.role: Supplies power distribution, energy management and automation, connecting the grid to data-center equipment.

companies.name: NVIDIA
companies.role: Designs GPUs and networking, and develops the software and systems that make accelerated computing usable at scale.

companies.name: AMD
companies.role: Designs Instinct accelerators and EPYC server CPUs, giving customers additional compute platforms.

companies.name: Broadcom
companies.role: Designs custom accelerators and networking silicon that connect large AI systems; also sells infrastructure software.

companies.name: TSMC
companies.role: Fabricates customers’ chip designs and provides advanced packaging, turning designs into manufacturable processors.

companies.name: Samsung Electronics
companies.role: Manufactures memory and logic chips, and offers foundry services; HBM supports high-bandwidth accelerator memory.

companies.name: Intel
companies.role: Designs processors and operates semiconductor fabs, including a foundry business for external customers.

companies.name: SK hynix
companies.role: Manufactures DRAM, NAND and high-bandwidth memory, helping accelerators keep data close to compute.

companies.name: Micron
companies.role: Manufactures DRAM, NAND and HBM; expands the memory and packaging supply that AI systems require.

companies.name: ASML
companies.role: Supplies lithography systems that print chip patterns on wafers, enabling foundries to manufacture advanced nodes.

companies.name: Vertiv
companies.role: Supplies power and thermal management to keep dense computing systems powered and cooled.

companies.name: Microsoft
companies.role: Operates Azure, provides model access and developer tools, and puts AI into work through Copilot applications.

companies.name: Amazon Web Services
companies.role: Rents cloud compute, designs Trainium chips and provides model access through Bedrock.

companies.name: Alphabet / Google
companies.role: Designs TPUs, operates Google Cloud, develops Gemini and integrates AI into consumer and workplace products.

companies.name: Meta
companies.role: Develops Llama models and applies AI to recommendations, advertising and consumer assistants.

companies.name: OpenAI
companies.role: Develops frontier models, sells API access and subscriptions, and provides ChatGPT for individual and workplace use.

companies.name: Anthropic
companies.role: Develops Claude models and tools such as Claude Code, supporting API use and enterprise workflows.

companies.name: Salesforce
companies.role: Integrates AI agents into customer relationship management, sales and service workflows through Agentforce.

companies.name: Palantir
companies.role: Connects organizational data to operational workflows and AI applications through its platforms and AIP.

supply_chain.title: Design
supply_chain.role: Architect the processor and its interconnects.
supply_chain.note: A chip designer may use an external foundry; cloud operators also design custom chips.

supply_chain.title: Fabrication
supply_chain.role: Pattern and process silicon wafers in fabs.
supply_chain.note: Foundry process, yield and available production slots matter alongside nameplate capacity.

supply_chain.title: Memory
supply_chain.note: HBM availability and qualification can limit complete accelerator supply.

supply_chain.title: Packaging
supply_chain.role: Connect compute and memory into a working device.
supply_chain.note: Advanced packaging is a separate production step. Foundry wafer starts do not measure packaging throughput.

supply_chain.title: Equipment
supply_chain.role: Provide the machines that make fabrication possible.
supply_chain.note: Lithography supports fabrication; additional equipment, materials and testing suppliers extend this chain.

employment.basis: Seasonally adjusted monthly payroll change; preliminary release, subject to revision.
employment.note: Broad sectors include activity unrelated to AI. These changes do not measure jobs caused or displaced by AI.

interpretation: The evidence supports an expansion of U.S. semiconductor and power-equipment manufacturing, with some production already operating. That is a concrete sign of industrial rebuilding. Project announcements and one month of employment data cannot establish a sustained economy-wide re-industrialization or net jobs attributable to AI.
gaps: No verified global total of usable AI accelerator capacity is available in this edition.
Comparable public HBM and advanced-packaging throughput series still need research.
